question:
Select the option that is related to the third letter-cluster in the same way as the second letter-cluster is related to the first letter-cluster.

KING : HFKD :: FRKM : ?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9b1ef5af07dc7cdface0347994bbc6f824cbda2bac27bcab0cb4cf07968dfa00.png] 

The logic followed here is: **Letter - 3**

For, KING : HFKD

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/028bdae665a75114e6d0b002cd39a92766ccce8c77eb0e2e798f83df3647e7f4.png] 

Similarly, for FRKM:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/82974dbc79594a07a6c7d499c52ae44b17fc9b1bd932cca56c06ab62e6a909df.png] 

So, 'FRKM' will be coded as 'COHJ'.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 4".
